Source: DataFrame query parity proposal v3 (item T9). Hypothesis, not a confirmed bug. Parameter alignment (dfparity-t04/t05) may change which queries diverge; re-check before fixing. Project owner does NOT accept earlier reviewers' TPC-H claims.

Progress 2026-10-01: fixed and published as PR #2500 (branch fix/tpcds-q98-no-limit, worktree ../BenchBox.wt-tpcds-q98-limit, head 0905d16e4), held, auto-merge withheld; make pr-preflight exit 0 on that head. CAUSE (TESTED): the shared helper _item_category_sales_* (Q12, Q20, Q98) hardcoded limit(100); Q12/Q20 templates have _LIMIT=100, Q98 has none (269 SQL rows vs 100 on both families at SF 0.1). A second defect was hidden behind it: SQL SUM over an all-NULL group is NULL, Polars/pandas give 0, so revenueratio was 0.0 instead of NULL (SQL result has 1 NULL-itemrevenue group in each of Q98 and Q20 at SF 0.1; Q98 also has one true-zero group that stays 0.0). Fix: limit is a spec argument (Q98 null) and null-preserving sums. Evidence: Q98, Q20, Q12 match on both families at SF 0.1; Q98 and Q12 at SF 0.03; gate at SF 0.01 unchanged (146/198 compared, 52 empty, 0 divergent); 4 of 8 new unit cases fail without the fix. Side effect: Q20 now matches at SF 0.1. OPEN FINDING: Q20 still diverges at SF 0.03 (ORDER BY key mismatch at position 55, both families), identical before the change; cause not diagnosed. Remaining: hosted CI, maintainer merge, then finish.
